title: Encrypted DNS Discovery Advertisement Planning Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for deterministic RFC 9463 advertisement planning.
scope: This verification covers DHCPv4, DHCPv6, and Neighbor Discovery payload selection for mixed-address input, ADN-only publication without addresses, IPv4-only family scoping, no-usable-address handling, and policy-blocked handling when all advertisement surfaces are disabled.
preconditions: The caller supplies local router or forwarder authentication domain name and optional LAN-facing resolver addresses.
A separate platform adapter is responsible for applying DHCP or Router Advertisement state.
expected_result: The focused advertisement planner tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, generated triage remains trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: Router and forwarder advertisement adapters are locally narrowed to deterministic DHCP and Router Advertisement payload planning. Live platform emission remains external adapter work.
